label: Actor Circular Value Network role
comment: The role(s) of an actor in a Circular Value Network, which is a specific type of collaboration.

label: Actor collaboration role
comment: The roles of an actor involved in a collaboration.

label: Actor process role
comment: The role(s) of an actor involved in a process.

label: Actor resource role
comment: The role(s) of an actor in relation to a resource.

label: Buying resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the buyer of a certain resource.

label: Circular Value Network Participation
comment: A participation-relation, that represents the participation of an actor in a CVN with a certain role. For instance, a specific company playing the role of recycler in a certain flow of a CVN. The participation may also be related to a certain time (or time interval).

label: Consuming resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the consumer of a certain resource.

label: Dismantling resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the dismantler of a certain resource.

label: Issuing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the issuer of a certain resource.

label: Manufacturing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the manufacturer of a certain resource.

label: Organisation
comment: Person or group of people that has its own functions with responsibilities, authorities, and relationships to achieve its objectives. The concept of organization includes, but is not limited to sole-trader, company, corporation, firm, enterprise, authority, partnership, charity or institution, or part or combination thereof, whether incorporated or not, public or private (e.g. foundation, union, association, agency, municipality, region, country, intergovernmental agencies). A group of organizations can also be considered as	an organization that has, alone or collectively,their own objectives.

label: Organisation Location
comment: Location of an organisation

label: Owning resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the owner of a certain resource.

label: Process Participation
comment: Participation of a certain actor in a certain process, with a certain role. For instance, a certain department of a recycling company having the role of quality controllant, or material sorter, in a certain recycling process. The participation may also be given a time, e.g. a start and end time.

label: Producing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the producer of a certain resource.

label: Providing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the provider of a certain resource.

label: Recycling resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the recycler of a certain resource.

label: Repairing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the repairer of a certain resource.

label: Reselling resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the reseller of a certain resource.

label: Selling resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the seller of a certain resource.

label: Stakeholder
comment: Person or organization that can affect, be affected by, or perceive itself to be affected by a decision or activity. To “perceive itself to be affected” means the perception has been made known to the organization.

label: Supplying resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the supplier of a certain resource.

label: Updating resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the updater of a certain resource.

label: Using resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the user of a certain resource.

label: Viewing resource
comment: The relation where the role of the actor is the viewer of a certain resource.

label: Resource Relation
comment: A relation between a resource, an actor, and the role the actor has in relation to the resource. For instance, the role of owner that a certain actor takes for a certain resource for a certain period of time. Or the seller of a certain resource, until that resource has been sold, and the actor no longer has that role in relation to the resource.

label: capability extent
comment: The extent of this capability, e.g. stating whether there are limist to the capability, such as a maximum amount or size of something.

label: has organisation location
comment: Represent that an organisation has some locations.

label: needed resource relations
comment: In order for an actor to have a capability, it needs to have certain resources, e.g. materials, infrastrucutre, know-how, information etc.

label: Actor
comment: An agent able to act in the context of a circular value network, e.g. an organisation, person.

label: Capability
comment: Something that the actor is capable of doing, e.g. perfomring a certain role in a process, based on some properties, such as access to infrastructure, resources and know-how.

label: Collaboration Participation
comment: The relation involving the role of a certain actor with respect to a value network or a process in such a network, e.g. an organisation (actor) acting as the recycler (role) in a glass recycling value netowrk (network) at a specific point or period in time. Or an organisation (actor) acting as the dismantler (role) in a dismantling step of a building deconstruction process (process step) at a specific point or period in time.

label: Infrastructure
comment: An infrastructure refers to facilities, services, or systems for participations to function.

label: Participation
comment: Represents the participation of objects in some situation.

label: Resource Participation
comment: The generic relation representing the particpation of a resource in some relation. For example, it can be specialized to represent a reified version of an object or data property.

label: Resource Relation
comment: The relation involving the role of a certain actor with respect to a certain resource, e.g. an organisation or individual (actor) owning (role) a specific product (resource) at a specific point or period in time.

label: Role
comment: A role that an actor can take in a specific context. Applies both to roles in the context of resources, such as owner, manufacturer, reseller etc. of that resource, as well as roles in relation to a circular value network, such as recycler, dismantler, transporter etc., in relation to a material flow.

label: based on capability
comment: An actor participates in a collaboration based on that it has some capability that is useful for the collaboration.

label: capability of
comment: Relates to the actor holding the capability.

label: capability property
comment: Relates some properties to the capability, such as the parameters of it, or the needed resources.

label: participant role
comment: Holds the value of the role of the participant in this participation relation.

label: participating actor
comment: Holds the value of the actor involved in this participation relation.

label: participating infrastructure
comment: Holds the value of the infrastructure involved in this participation relation.

label: participating object
comment: Participating object in a resource participation. This is part of a resource participation that can be a directional relation, and the participating object is the end point of the relation.

label: participating resource
comment: The resource that this participation relation relates to, i.e. for which the actor holds the specified role.

label: participating subject
comment: Participating subject in a resource participation. This is part of a resource participation that can be a directional relation, and the participating subject is the starting point of the relation.

label: participation in
comment: The collaboration or process that this participation relates to.

label: participation end time
comment: The end of a time interval.

label: participation start time
comment: The start of a time interval.

label: participation time point
comment: The point in time when something took place or was valid.

label: Data Sheet
comment: A data sheet is a collection of data about something, e.g. a set of facts about a product.

label: Compliance
comment: Represents that something is compliant with some standard or has a received a certain certification.

label: Composition
comment: A relation that represents a composing relation.

label: ISO Compliance
comment: ISO compliance is a compliance issuing thay sth (e.g., organization's structure, business operations, practices or policies) follows a specific ISO standard.

label: Item
comment: An item is a physical object put into a market for sale, i.e. corresponding to an individual of a product. The item can be a thing that grows naturally or produced through some chemical or manufacturing processes.

label: Manufacture Location
comment: The location where a physical object is manufactured.

label: Matter composition
comment: A product composition is the composed information of a product in terms of a specific component, in which such a component is also a matter.

label: Origin Location
comment: The origin location of a physical object

label: Product
comment: Physical-based object designed for or utilized with a purpose. A product can be, for example: goods of any type; hardware (e.g. engine mechanical part, spare parts, consumables); electrical or electronic hardware devices or components (e.g. computers, communication equipment and sensors); processed materials (e.g. lubricant, cement).

label: Product composition
comment: A product composition is the composed information of a product in terms of a specific component, in which such a component is also a product.

label: Product Object Composition
comment: A product object composition is the composed information of a product object in terms of a specific component, in which such a component is also a product object.

label: Production Location
comment: The production location of a physical object

label: REACH Compliance
comment: REACH (Regulation on the registration, evaluation, authorisation and restriction of chemicals) compliance is a compliance issueing that the REACH regulation is satisfied.

label: Regulation
comment: The rules or restrictions made or maintained by authorities.

label: RoHS Compliance
comment: RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment) compliance is a compliance issuing that RoHS objectives are satisfied.

label: Solution
comment: Product or service, or a combination thereof, that fulfils a need of an interested party.

label: Supplier Location
